sources.snippet: A full stack platform for Edge AI By combining an AI-first, standards-based hardware architecture with a unified developer experience, Coral enables efficient and local AI experiences at the edge.

sources.title: Models - All | Coral
sources.snippet: This page lists all our trained models that are compiled for the Coral Edge TPU™. For more information about each model type, including code examples and training scripts, refer to the model-specific pages that are linked on the Models page. To train a custom model, using transfer learning or by building and training your own model, see our documentation about TensorFlow models on the Edge TPU.

sources.title: Build Coral for your platform
sources.snippet: The setup guide for each Coral device shows you how to install the required software and run an inference on the Edge TPU. However, our pre-built software components are not compatible with all platform variants.
